metadata.name: image.decode
metadata.description: (png) → { w, h, rgba }. Decode PNG bytes (Uint8Array, base64 string, or data: URL) to an RGBA8 pixel buffer and its dimensions — via the browser canvas (createImageBitmap + OffscreenCanvas) when present, else a dependency-free pure-JS PNG codec (8-bit RGB/RGBA). Returns a CelError on undecodable input.

metadata.name: image.encode
metadata.description: (rgba, w, h) → base64 PNG. Encode an RGBA8 byte buffer of size 4·w·h to lossless 8-bit PNG bytes (base64), so LSBs survive the round trip. Returns a CelError if the buffer is too small.

metadata.name: image.fit
metadata.description: (png, maxDim) → base64 PNG downscaled so max(w,h) ≤ maxDim (decode → resample → encode); a byte-preserving no-op when the image is already within bounds. maxDim is an argument — no policy here.
